LESSON: WISE MEN

Grade: Grade 3
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: The
Topic 3.1: Wise men

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Wise men. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Explain the main ideas in Wise men
2. Practise Wise men at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Wise men

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Explain the main ideas in Wise men
   In simple words: practise until you can explain the main ideas in Wise men. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. Practise Wise men at school and at home
   In simple words: practise until you can practise Wise men at school and at home. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Wise men
   In simple words: practise until you can give Kenyan examples connected to Wise men. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Wise men using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Wise men in the examples.
2. Explain Wise men to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Wise men.
4. Practise one skill from this lesson with a friend.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Wise men using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Wise men important for a Grade 3 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.
